scope.boundary: CALL instructions and flag getter execute; imported allocator, handler and error accessor instructions do not
scope.claim: Exact wrapper, candidate thunk and flag getter agree with independent finite protocol and memory oracle
scope.flags: TEST and XOR omit undefined AF; initial zero INC and oversized CMP compare all six arithmetic flags
not_claimed: HeapAlloc success or actual heap state
Handler or error accessor effects beyond supplied response

summaries.heap_return: Host consumes return word plus twelve argument bytes
summaries.preserves: All other registers and all mapped memory, including temporary arguments and globals
summaries.volatile_outputs: EAX supplied; ECX and EDX sampled by response index; flags set to 0x246
